items.title: Tesla to launch Cybercabs in Austin starting Sept. 3
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian reports on Tesla (TSLA) launching Cybercabs starting on Sept. 3 in Austin. The company expects to roll out 2,500 robotaxis in 2026.

items.title: Tesla Cybercab to launch Sept. 3 as robotaxi bet ramps up
items.summary: Tesla will unveil the production Cybercab at a launch event in Austin, Texas, on Sept. 3. This comes as Tesla ramps up its self-driving efforts — key to the company's big growth plans.

items.title: Tesla stops selling solar roofs a decade after launch
items.summary: Aug 24 (Reuters) - Tesla has stopped selling premium solar roof tiles on its website, nearly a decade after CEO Elon Musk launched the product as a more attractive alternative to panels.
